deterministic.proposal:
PROCEDURE move_last_reminder_and_return_call_person(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND_LAST REMINDER
UPDATE $v0 WHEN={time}
$v1 = CHILD $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END

external.program:
PROCEDURE move_last_reminder_and_return_call_person()
$v0 = FIND_LAST REMINDER
UPDATE $v0 WHEN=5:45
$v1 = CHILD $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
